caption: The drawing depicts a single, red metal teapot with a cylindrical body and a slightly domed, circular lid that features a small, brass or gold-colored knob at the top center. The body of the teapot is painted red and shows areas where the paint has chipped or worn away, revealing patches of a grayish material underneath and creating an irregular, mottled texture. There are decorative gold or brass-colored bands encircling the lid and base, as well as a curved handle attached to the upper part of the body and lid, extending downward. The spout is short, widens toward the base, and is also painted red with signs of wear. On the side of the teapot, a vertical glass or acrylic window is inset, bordered by a thin gold or brass strip, and divided into three segments by two thin horizontal lines, possibly indicating measurement levels. The overall composition is centered on a plain, off-white background and is rendered with careful attention to the metallic shine, texture, and reflective qualities of the teapot.
title: Toleware Coffee Pot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
